name: Claim-measurement discrepancy
formula: median over items/sections of |claimed - measured| / measured

name: Share of claimed quantity independently verified
formula: verified claimed quantity / total claimed quantity (by value)

name: Daily production review time
formula: minutes spent by reviewer to review one day of production

name: Errors detected per review
formula: number of errors/inconsistencies found per daily review

name: DPR completeness
formula: mandatory fields filled / mandatory fields required

name: DPR timeliness
formula: hours from shift end to approved DPR

name: Decision latency
formula: hours from deviation occurrence to documented decision/action

name: Disputed line items per certificate
formula: count of BoQ line items disputed / items certified

name: Certification cycle time
formula: days from period end to approved certificate

name: Payment cycle time
formula: days from approved certificate to payment

name: Commercial admin effort
formula: person-hours spent on reconciliation and disputes per claim

name: Crew productivity
formula: quantity produced / crew-hours per activity per section

name: Equipment utilisation visibility
formula: equipment hours with known activity assignment / total equipment hours

name: Delay-signal lead time
formula: date slowdown recognised in conventional report - date flagged by system
